articles.title: Anthropic Releases Claude 4 with Extended Reasoning and 2M Token Context
articles.summary: Anthropic has officially launched Claude 4, featuring a breakthrough 2 million token context window and enhanced chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities. The model reportedly outperforms competitors on complex multi-step coding and scientific analysis benchmarks. The release includes a new API tier targeting enterprise customers with stricter safety filtering options.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2.5 Achieves Top Scores on New AGI Readiness Benchmark
articles.summary: Google DeepMind published results showing Gemini Ultra 2.5 achieving unprecedented scores on the newly established AGI Readiness Evaluation Suite (ARES), a benchmark developed by a consortium of academic institutions. The model demonstrated strong performance in abstract reasoning, tool use, and autonomous planning tasks. Researchers caution that high benchmark scores do not imply general intelligence but acknowledge the results are a significant milestone.

articles.title: OpenAI Launches Operator Pro: Autonomous AI Agents for Enterprise Workflows
articles.summary: OpenAI has expanded its Operator platform with a new Pro tier designed to handle complex, multi-day autonomous workflows for enterprise clients. Operator Pro can manage email, calendar scheduling, CRM updates, and cross-platform data retrieval with minimal human oversight. Early adopters including Salesforce and SAP report productivity gains of up to 40% in back-office operations.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Body Issues First Major Fine to European AI Startup
articles.summary: The newly operational EU AI Office levied a €47 million fine against Berlin-based AI startup Synthex for deploying a high-risk facial recognition system without completing the required conformity assessments. The case marks the first significant enforcement action under the fully enacted EU AI Act. Legal analysts say the ruling sets a precedent that will accelerate compliance efforts across European AI companies.

articles.title: Meta Releases Open-Source Multimodal Model Chameleon 3 with Video Understanding
articles.summary: Meta AI has open-sourced Chameleon 3, a multimodal model capable of processing interleaved text, images, audio, and full video sequences up to 10 minutes in length. The model is available under a permissive research license and includes weights for both 7B and 70B parameter variants. Developers have already begun fine-tuning the model for video captioning, accessibility tools, and surveillance analytics.

articles.title: New RAG Framework 'HyperRAG' Claims 60% Reduction in Hallucination Rates
articles.summary: Researchers from Stanford and Carnegie Mellon have introduced HyperRAG, a retrieval-augmented generation framework that dynamically re-ranks and cross-validates retrieved chunks using a secondary verification model. In evaluations across medical and legal QA datasets, HyperRAG reduced hallucination rates by approximately 60% compared to standard RAG pipelines. The framework and code have been released publicly on GitHub.

articles.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio Adds Real-Time Web Grounding and Custom Tool Plugins
articles.summary: Microsoft announced a major update to Copilot Studio, enabling enterprise developers to ground AI responses in real-time web data and integrate custom third-party tool plugins via an expanded API. The update also introduces a visual agent builder that allows non-technical users to design multi-step AI workflows using a drag-and-drop interface. The features are rolling out to all Microsoft 365 commercial tenants this week.

articles.title: AI Safety Institute Publishes Red-Teaming Report Exposing Jailbreak Vulnerabilities in Six Leading LLMs
articles.summary: The UK AI Safety Institute released a comprehensive red-teaming report identifying previously undisclosed jailbreak techniques that bypassed safety guardrails in six major language models, including models from OpenAI, Google, and Mistral. The report details 23 novel attack vectors and rates each model's resilience across categories including bioweapon uplift, cyberattack assistance, and disinformation generation. All affected vendors have been notified and several have already pushed patches in response.
